entities.name: Riza
entities.description: An Abzan Captain in Tarkir's original timeline leading a Salt Road patrol.

entities.name: Ogan Shieldmender
entities.description: Soldier Riza ordered to form a shield wall at the canyon mouth.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: Clan whose patrols guard the Salt Road.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: Clan whose horde burned a shepherds' camp.

entities.name: Canyon Falls
entities.description: Oasis where Riza's patrol made its stand.

events.summary: Riza's patrol found a shepherds' camp burned by the Mardu and followed the horde.
events.quote: one of the shepherds' summer camps had been ravaged and burned to the ground by Mardu with not a single survivor

events.summary: Riza decided to fall back to the oasis at Canyon Falls to await the larger patrol.
events.quote: Riza announced that they would fall back to the oasis at Canyon Falls

events.summary: Riza set up a defense in the canyon, with Ogan Shieldmender forming a shield wall.
events.quote: Riza bid Ogan Shieldmender array his men at the mouth of the canyon and form a shield wall.

events.summary: As the Mardu converged, an Abzan siege elephant of the larger patrol appeared.

relations.quote: Riza was an Abzan Captain in Tarkir 's original timeline.
They followed the Mardu horde, who had twice their number.
